name: Kibanohara Ethica
source:
A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency.

[Spoiler]Birthed from Aso Yukari's womb using a fertilized egg created with induced pluripotent stem cells from [url=/c41456]Kibanohara Hokoyasu[/url] and Nagaoka Takeyuki.[/spoiler] 
Raised together with [url=/c34601]Aso Kiriri[/url] like sisters.

Acts based on her gut instinct; the type to shoot first, ask questions later. A lesbian who just can't get enough of pretty girls.

Capable of wielding a wide variety of weapons like the [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_ak50_anim.gif]AK-50 Kalashnikov[/url] and the [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_aa24_anim.gif]AA-24 Custom[/url], based on what a given combat situation demands. Her go-to is a portable chainsaw called [Url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/tokyonecro/img/weapon_rabbit-punch_anim.gif]Rabbit Punch[/url].

[Edited from the in-game profile]
